pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 6
   C. 18
   D. 7

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 22

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 6

2. D — 23.6

3. A — 27.6

4. A — 12x + 2

5. A — 19.6

6. A — 1

7. A — 10 000 m²

8. D — 1/2

9. A — 32
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Perimeter = 2(L + W)
2. Substitute values: P = 2(11 + 5)
3. P = 2(16)
4. P = 32
Final Answer: 32 cm
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

10. C — 1

11. A — 1

12. D — 40

2. Substitute values: P = 2(15 + 5)
3. P = 2(20)
4. P = 40
Final Answer: 40 cm
